passage.quote: List gives an overview of the descriptions without loading all their prose into the response.

from.quote: The command loads the selected project at the requested revision, defaulting to working content. Its JSON result contains the resolved project and revision, description identities, titles, parent identities, implementation status, and project issues. The hierarchy is represented by parent references in a flat collection.

The projection is built from the same loaded descriptions used elsewhere in Stratic. Readable drafts therefore remain present even when metadata is incomplete, and their issues accompany the result. List does not independently reconstruct or repair a hierarchy that the loader rejected.
